newsitem.title: UK: Johnson Matthey to pay final div as FID.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Matthey to pay final div as FID.

text.p: British metals and electronic materials group Johnson Matthey Plc said on Friday it was to pay its final dividend of 10.8 pence a share for the year to March 31, 1997 in the form of a foreign income dividend (FID).
The decision follows changes to taxation on dividends made in the UK budget last week.
The company said in a statement that by paying the final dividend in the form of a FID it would be able to obtain a refund of the 5.8 million stg of advance corporation tax (ACT) paid on the FID.
It said for the majority of shareholders, payment of the dividend in this way would have no adverse financial effect. The dividend will be paid on August 4.
